rationale.overall: The two takes are near-identical apart from the ribbon curl, and B's curl reads as a rounded translucent volume much closer to the REFERENCE, so B wins on the only axis that differentiates them.
rationale.material: A's curl has a flat, hard-edged grey patch inside the loop that reads as a cutout, while B's shows smooth gradient falloff around the cylinder plus a soft contact shadow at its base — matching the REFERENCE's translucent, light-transmitting ribbon; the slab material (glassy dark body, warm rim glow) is identical in both and slightly glassier than the REFERENCE's chalky stone in each case.
rationale.silhouette: Both share the same slab angle, edge geometry, and horizon split against the REFERENCE, with only a negligible difference in the curl's outer contour.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16px the slab and its orange rim dominate identically in both strips, and the curl difference collapses into the same pale blob, so neither take gains a legibility edge.
